puzzle.title: The City Turned Upside Down
puzzle.intro: In a valley steeped in corruption, one faithful soul stood alone against the tide. Tasked with calling a defiant community back to purity, this figure faced mockery, threats, and ultimate destruction descending from the sky.
clues: I was sent as a messenger to a community that transgressed all bounds.
I warned my people about an immorality that no nation before them had committed.
I offered guidance in purity, but my people mocked me and demanded punishment instead.
I prayed to Allah for help against my corrupt people when they threatened to expel me.
Angels came to me in the form of guests, and I feared for them because of my people.
I was commanded to leave by night with my followers, and stones of baked clay rained upon those left behind.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: Prophet Shuayb
Prophet Lut
Prophet Idris
Prophet Salih
Prophet Hud

trial.label: What Was The Crime Of My People?
options: Hamstringing the she-camel of Allah
Committing shameful immorality unknown to any nation before
Building lofty towers out of arrogance
Worshipping the golden calf in absence of their leader
Withholding measure and weight in trade
trial.answer: Committing shameful immorality unknown to any nation before

location.label: What Was Sent Against The Transgressors?
options: A flood that covered the mountaintops
Stones of baked clay marked by your Lord
A mighty blast that seized them at sunrise
Birds carrying stones against an army with elephants
A swarm of locusts, lice and frogs
location.answer: Stones of baked clay marked by your Lord

outcome.label: What Was My Final Outcome?
options: I was raised alive to the heavens
I was swallowed by a great fish then forgiven
I was thrown into fire that became cool and safe
I was saved with my followers except my spouse who was left behind
I slept in a cave for many years
outcome.answer: I was saved with my followers except my spouse who was left behind

puzzle.arabic: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
puzzle.verse: So We brought out whoever was in them [i.e., the cities] of the believers. (51:35)
